dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Progressive myoclonus–ataxia syndrome, most consistent with cortical myoclonus of currently undetermined cause

ALTERNATIVE 1: Functional movement disorder with functional tremor and gait ataxia

ALTERNATIVE 2: Early or genetically mediated hereditary spinocerebellar ataxia

ALTERNATIVE 3: Immune-mediated or gluten-sensitive cerebellar ataxia with myoclonus
